name: Stack Cart
summary: A mini cart drawer whose thumbnails stack up as you add, with rolling digits and a free delivery scooter
about: A side drawer cart for a small shop. Each row has a quantity stepper; every extra unit fans another card behind the thumbnail, and line prices, subtotal and total roll like odometer drums. A scooter rides a free delivery meter and pops a wheelie with confetti when the order passes PKR 6,000; removing a row slides it away with an Undo.
how: Press the cart icon or + Add on a product: the shop sinks back and the drawer springs in with staggered rows
Use + and − on a row: the thumbnail squashes, a card fans in or out behind it and every price digit rolls
Pass PKR 6,000 and the scooter pops a wheelie, the meter turns lime and delivery becomes free
At one item the minus becomes a bin: the row slides out, the gap closes and Undo brings it back
Checkout fills a striped bar, ticks, throws confetti and empties the cart; Fill the cart again resets it
